options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: contenttypeautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: contenttypeminthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold to learn Content Type information.

options.name: contenttypepercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold in percent to learn Content Type information.

options.name: cookieconsistencyautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: cookieconsistencyminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn cookies.

options.name: cookieconsistencypercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular cookie pattern for the learning engine to learn that cookie.

options.name: creditcardnumberminthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold to learn Credit Card information.

options.name: creditcardnumberpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum threshold in percent to learn Credit Card information.

options.name: crosssitescriptingautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: crosssitescriptingminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn HTML cross-site scripting patterns.

options.name: crosssitescriptingpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular cross-site scripting pattern for the learning engine to learn that cross-site scripting pattern.

options.name: csrftagautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: csrftagminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn cross-site request forgery (CSRF) tags.

options.name: csrftagpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular CSRF tag for the learning engine to learn that CSRF tag.

options.name: fieldconsistencyautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: fieldconsistencyminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn field consistency information.

options.name: fieldconsistencypercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular field consistency pattern for the learning engine to learn that field consistency pattern.

options.name: fieldformatautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: fieldformatminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn field formats.

options.name: fieldformatpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular web form field pattern for the learning engine to recommend a field format for that form field.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: profilename
options.description: Name of the profile.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sqlinjectionautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: sqlinjectionminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn HTML SQL injection patterns.

options.name: sqlinjectionpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular HTML SQL injection pattern for the learning engine to learn that HTML SQL injection pattern.

options.name: starturlautodeploygraceperiod
options.description: The number of minutes after the threshold hit alert the learned rule will be deployed

options.name: starturlminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn start URLs.

options.name: starturlpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular start URL pattern for the learning engine to learn that start URL.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: xmlattachmentminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn XML attachment patterns.

options.name: xmlattachmentpercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular XML attachment pattern for the learning engine to learn that XML attachment pattern.

options.name: xmlwsiminthreshold
options.description: Minimum number of application firewall sessions that the learning engine must observe to learn web services interoperability (WSI) information.

options.name: xmlwsipercentthreshold
options.description: Minimum percentage of application firewall sessions that must contain a particular pattern for the learning engine to learn a web services interoperability (WSI) pattern.
